llmResponse.agenda_changes: Item 13.1 (Recognition of Classified Employees) was moved from its original position to immediately after Oral Communication (before it was discussed, the board then moved it to before Oral Communication). Additionally, items 6.2 and 6.3 were moved from consent to action due to public comments on bond items. The board also noted that item 6.1 (Approval of Comprehensive School Safety Plans) had already been approved in closed session.
